# spyro caddy

Manage Caddy web server on remote server.

## Before you run it

Service group for Caddy hosts (`status`, `version`, `restart`). `restart` needs a profile with `sudo = true`.

Read `spyro profiles` first for hosts and `remote_path`; the `spyro` skill has the safety rules.

## Reference (from `--help`)

### `spyro caddy`

```text
Usage: spyro caddy [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Manage Caddy web server on remote server.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  restart  Restart Caddy.
  status   Show Caddy server status.
  version  Show Caddy version.
```

### `spyro caddy restart`

```text
Usage: spyro caddy restart [OPTIONS]

  Restart Caddy.

Options:
  -p, --profile TEXT  Profile name  [required]
  --timeout FLOAT     Timeout in seconds (default: 30)
  --help              Show this message and exit.
```

### `spyro caddy status`

```text
Usage: spyro caddy status [OPTIONS]

  Show Caddy server status.

Options:
  -p, --profile TEXT  Profile name  [required]
  --help              Show this message and exit.
```

### `spyro caddy version`

